biography.value: A recruiter, debt collector, or naval officer who fills a ship by force. Press-gang enforcers are trained to seize people quickly, break resistance, and keep frightened captives moving toward the docks.

system.tactics: Enforcers work in pairs. One blocks escape while the other uses Intimidate and grapples. They prefer clubs and restraints when the goal is capture, but abandon restraint when the target fights back.
system.attacksNotes:
Club [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 4), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 8 damage (4 + 4 Str)
  • Margin 2: 8 damage, DR halved (round up)
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Feats

Defensive Stance: Can enter a defensive stance as a toggle. While in defensive stance, opponents add 1 to both attack dice when attacking you. Can enter or leave this stance at the start of your turn. Shield Master: Subtract 1 from both dice on Reflex saves while using a shield. Once per combat as a [Reaction], completely negate one attack that would hit you. Formation Fighting: When you and at least two allies adjacent to you are all wielding shields, all of you gain +2 DR. When an adjacent ally is attacked, you can use a [Reaction] to grant them -2 to both dice on their defense roll.
system.reactionsNotes: Shield Block (from Buckler): [Reaction] when hit while wielding the buckler, choose one: gain +4 DR against this attack or force the attacker to reroll one success die. Shield Master Negation: Once per combat as a [Reaction], completely negate one attack that would hit you.
